impact.text: nested multicalls revert even in benign cases (e.g., inner batch does nothing)

precondition_sources.text: An outer multicall() batch is executed with a nonzero top-level msg.value that the outer batch intends to forward later.
An inner multicall() is nested within the outer batch and executes via delegatecall in the same execution context.
The inner multicall() does not itself forward any ETH.

intent_sources.text: Nested multicalls should remain composable and not revert in benign cases such as an inner batch that does nothing, so integrations relying on multi-level batching and deferred ETH forwarding within the outer batch continue to work.
